title: Research note
description: One pass of background research on a single clause. The researcher accumulates these over time; each pass either deepens internally (cross-corpus echoes) or reaches outward (external case studies, kin, sources). A clause's research file is an append-only list of these.

clause_id.description: ID of the clause this note is research for (e.g. 'book-erotism-021').

pass_kind.description: What kind of pass this is. Distinct kinds answer distinct questions; the UI groups them differently.

pass_number.description: Monotonic counter within this clause's research file. Pass N+1 must NOT repeat findings from passes 1..N — model is prompted with prior summaries to enforce.

lens.description: One-sentence restatement of the clause's lens, in the researcher's own words. Used to confirm the researcher is on-target before consuming output.

claim.description: One declarative sentence — the new thing this pass adds.

evidence.description: Where the claim comes from: a passage (with page/line), a source URL, a cross-corpus echo (with file:line).

source_ref.description: Stable reference: file:line or URL or page citation. Optional but strongly preferred.

next_seeds.description: ⊕ seeds for the next pass. Researcher proposes what to do next so the queue self-sustains.

directive.description: One-line task for the next researcher pass.

warnings.description: Things the researcher itself is unsure about or wants flagged for human attention.
